text:
A coat of ink and ivory, stark and bright,
The zebra stands, a living work of art.
Within the garden’s hush, the shadows light,
As nature whispers secrets to the heart.

The flowers bloom with promises untold,
Their petals unfurl in silent grace,
Revealing splendor, ancient and bold,
In every curve and soft, delicate face.

The trees stand sentinels, wise and still,
Their leaves rustle with ages past,
A green haven where the spirit will
Find solace in the cycles built to last.

Here growth is simple, life’s eternal song,
Each bloom and withering leaf tells the tale,
Of time’s passage, where we all belong,
In nature’s quiet, ever-changing veil.
